title: 1956 AHSME Problem 16
statement: The sum of three numbers is \(98.\) The ratio of the first to the second is \(\dfrac23,\) and the ratio of the second to the third is \(\dfrac58.\) The second number is:

solutions.text:
The first-to-second ratio \(2:3\) and second-to-third ratio \(5:8\) combine to give the three-number ratio \(10:15:24.\) The \(49\) total parts equal \(98,\) so each part is \(2.\) The second number is \(15\cdot2=30.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Choose a common scaling so the three numbers have ratio \(10:15:24\)
